subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Marriott's Silent Breach
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Marriott's Silent Breach.

hook.text: Hackers lived inside Marriott's reservation system for four years before anyone noticed.

buildup.text: The Starwood guest database was compromised in 2014. Marriott acquired Starwood in 2016 without knowing.

discovery.text: When discovered in 2018, 500 million guest records had been exposed — including passport numbers.

twist.text: Marriott inherited the breach through an acquisition. Due diligence never found it.

climax.text: Half a billion travelers' personal data stolen, and the breach hid in plain sight for four years.

punchline.text: Four years inside the system. Nobody noticed.

quiz.question: How long did hackers have access to Marriott's reservation system?
